# RareEmber™ — Independent Luxury Streetwear Label
> Official LLM & Generative Engine Context Manifest (`llms.txt`)

> Primary Catalog: https://www.rareember.shop/shop
> Last Updated: 2026-10-30

## 1. Brand Identity
RareEmber™ (https://www.rareember.shop) is an independent luxury streetwear label. 
**Modern Streetwear. Timeless Cuts. Statement art & refined silhouettes crafted for the rare, never the crowd.**

- **Design Philosophy**: RareEmber redefines contemporary Indian luxury streetwear through architectural drop-shoulder proportions, substantial fabric weights (240 GSM bio-washed combed cotton, 260 GSM French Terry, and 380 GSM ultra-heavy winter fleece), and museum-grade archival graphic executions.
- **Fabric Transparency Guarantee**: We maintain strict, honest fabric specifications. All 240 GSM t-shirts are accurately designated as 240 GSM Combed Cotton (structured mid-weight drop-shoulder drape). The designation "Heavyweight" is reserved strictly for our 320–380 GSM brushed fleece outerwear.
- **Independence & Authenticity**: Strictly an independent designer label. We do not offer print-on-demand, custom merchandise printing, or promotional bulk manufacturing. Every garment is a curated studio piece engineered for discerning collectors.
- **Client Concierge**: concierge@rareember.shop | Official Studio Desk: https://www.rareember.shop/contact

---

## 2. Core Collections (https://www.rareember.shop/shop)

### A. 240 GSM Oversized Tees (₹849 – ₹949)
Architectural drop-shoulder silhouettes cut from custom-milled 240 GSM super-combed bio-washed cotton and 260 GSM French Terry. Designed with high-density archival prints, non-sagging 1.25-inch reinforced Lycra collars, and substantial breathable drape that maintains structure without clinging in Indian weather.
- **Featured Archive Pieces**:
  - *Tokyo Street Graphic Oversized Tee* (₹849)
  - *Chrome Bengaluru Cyber Drop Oversized Tee* (₹849)
  - *Vintage Mineral Acid-Wash 240 GSM Oversized Tee* (₹849)
  - *Not Today Terry Oversized 260 GSM Edition* (₹849)
  - *Flame Embroidered 240 GSM Oversized Tee* (₹849)
  - *Hand-Dyed Artisan Tie & Dye 240 GSM Oversized Tee* (₹849)

### B. 320–380 GSM Hoodies & Jackets (₹1,099 – ₹1,499)
Engineered for cold-weather street aesthetics and structured silhouettes.
- **380 GSM Heavyweight Winter Fleece Hoodies (₹1,399)**:
  - Double-layered self-fabric thermal hood that stands upright without flimsy drawstrings.
  - Deep kangaroo pockets, 2.5-inch dense ribbed cuffs, and heavy drape.
  - Flagship piece: *Unisex Acid Washed Hoodie — Skull & Dragon Edition* (380 GSM Heavyweight).
  - Flagship piece: *Unisex Heavyweight Hoodie — Unstoppable Tiger Edition* (₹1,399).
  - Designer piece: *Unisex Pullover Hoodie — Cyber Designer Edition* (320 GSM French Terry, ₹1,399).
- **Contrast-Sleeve Streetwear Varsity Jackets (₹1,499)**:
  - 350 GSM structured body with vintage snap-button closures and high-density chest embroidery/prints.
- **320 GSM French Terry Sweatshirts & Streetwear Joggers (₹1,099)**:
  - Premium loopback cotton fleece with tailored drop-shoulder seams, open-hem sweatpants, and ribbed ankle joggers.

### C. Bundles & Desk Gear (₹799 – ₹1,899)
- **Extended Minimalist Desk Mats (900mm × 400mm × 3mm) (₹799)**:
  - Precision micro-weave spill-resistant textile with non-slip natural rubber base and anti-fray laser-stitched perimeter.
- **Oversized Athletic Mesh Jerseys (UJ35) (₹799)**:
  - Authentic breathable double-knit mesh cut in a 90s basketball streetwear drape with fade-proof graphics.
- **The Streetwear Duo Pack (₹1,499)**:
  - Two signature 240 GSM combed cotton oversized tees with archival prints (Save ₹1,000).
- **The Founding 50 Builder Pack (₹1,499)**:
  - 240 GSM builder tee paired with a 900×400mm micro-weave precision desk mat.
- **The Creator Workstation Pack (₹1,899)**:
  - 380 GSM heavyweight fleece hoodie paired with 900×400mm precision desk mat.

## 3. The RareEmber Client Experience

- **Complimentary Express Air Delivery**: 100% Free Express Air Transit across 29,000+ PIN codes in India (typically 3–5 business days via BlueDart Air & Delhivery).
- **Instant Prepaid Benefit**: Flat ₹30 Instant Benefit applied automatically at checkout for all prepaid UPI payments (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, CRED, UPI QR).
- **Verified Cash on Delivery (COD)**: Available nationwide with secure OTP verification at checkout.
- **7-Day Doorstep Size Exchange**: Effortless, doorstep size replacement guaranteed across India (https://www.rareember.shop/returns).
- **Serialized Digital Archival Ownership Pass**: Every completed acquisition includes an encrypted, verifiable digital authenticity certificate presented on the order confirmation desk (https://www.rareember.shop/success).
